findings.summary: Not-applicable declarations are honour-system (free text), and cases._views swallows NoModel so model-side halves of shared cases are skipped silently; a third-party driver could pass while violating a case.
repair.new_proposal_or_clarification passes a driver that re-proposes the identical blocked proposal (bounded by the kernel's repair budget and KERNEL-REPEAT).

The pydantic-ai silence fix changes run behaviour in every rollout including off: a reasoning-only reply after a finding now parks the run in WAITING_INPUT with a fixed question, instead of a bounded re-drive or VERIFICATION_FAILED. Owner ruling.
OUTSIDE_TOOL_SET as a FinalAnswer on a run with no reads becomes an INPUT_REQUESTED reply (fixture-only edge).
Resolved: the stateless scripted repair cannot loop (every re-drive carries findings, bounded by budgets); no golden changed; authored responses labelled; first failures reproduced on base drivers.
findings.evidence: Reviewer ran the suite on git archive b78786a; 249 passed at HEAD.
